_comment: Pointer to heavy render baselines hosted as GitHub release assets for
tests/full_renders and tests/path_traced. tests/fast stays in git because
it is the only render baseline normal CI compares and is intentionally small.
The heavy expected_outputs_<key>/ MP4s are not committed. A local directory
created by a rebaseline still wins over the release asset so it can be
inspected and packaged before publication. Otherwise tests/baseline_store.py
downloads the archive named by 'tag', verifies this sha256, and caches it.
scripts/package_baselines.py carries unchanged device archives forward when
publishing a new tag, so one machine need not possess every device baseline.
